rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Stacks Clarity MCP Server provides comprehensive tooling for Stacks blockchain development, offering 32+ specialized tools covering SIP standards access, token development (SIP-009 NFTs and SIP-010 fungible tokens), security analysis with mandatory post-conditions, SIP-012 performance optimization, account management, and Clarinet project generation. Built by Exponent Labs with TypeScript and integrated with Hiro APIs, it enforces security best practices by requiring post-conditions for all token transfers, provides real-time blockchain data access, and generates production-ready Clarity contracts with test suites, making it valuable for developers building DeFi protocols, NFT marketplaces, DAOs, and other Stacks applications while ensuring SIP compliance and optimal performance.
